intro: Import transactions from a statement file your bank lets you download: OFX, QFX, QIF, CAMT or CSV.
unsupportedBody: Choose an OFX, QFX, QIF, CAMT (.xml) or CSV file.
failedRows_one: {{count}} row could not be read and will be skipped.
failedRows_other: {{count}} rows could not be read and will be skipped.
parseError: The columns could not be recognised. Map them below.
flipAmountsHint: For files that show spending as positive numbers.
splitColumnsHint: For files with one column for money in and another for money out.
noAccounts: Create an account first, then import into it.
detectDuplicatesHint: Leave out transactions that are already in the account.
doneBody: Imported {{imported}}. Skipped as duplicates: {{skipped}}. Left out: {{excluded}}.
historyIntro: Undo an import to delete every transaction it added.
undoBody_one: The {{count}} transaction imported from {{file}} will be deleted.
undoBody_other: The {{count}} transactions imported from {{file}} will be deleted.
